title: Reusable Data Procedures
purpose: Turn repeated spreadsheet and corporate-export analysis into explicit, testable procedures that can be reused on later file sets.

workflow.responsibility: Load one or more files and expose worksheets as table candidates.
Infer column types, completeness, uniqueness, likely keys, and value samples.
Rank cross-table field relations using header similarity, value overlap, and type compatibility. Human approval remains explicit.
Measure source coverage, source nulls, target duplicates, and unmatched values against the current rows.
Build an inspectable lookup result and keep the transformation direction visible.
Store logic and structural expectations without storing uploaded business data.

source_signature.note: A later run resolves a saved source against newly uploaded tables by structural similarity, not only by an exact file name.

mapping_scoring.interpretation: A suggestion is a hypothesis, not a semantic truth. Business meaning must be confirmed before reuse.

runtime.spreadsheet_parser: SheetJS Community Edition standalone browser build

use_cases: SAP transactional exports joined to master data
boundaries: The prototype does not infer business semantics beyond observable structure and values.
Duplicate target keys require review because the result preview uses the first matching row.
Procedures saved in localStorage are browser-local until exported as JSON.
Production use with sensitive data requires an approved dependency, security, privacy, and deployment model.
